scenarios.title: Overlay pin / reinstall / removal
scenarios.steps: Run ALIFE-09 read-only full pinned source verifier LF and CRLF then dry-run installer twice and reverse
scenarios.expected: No SOURCE_DRIFT, both installs byte-identical, full rollback byte-identical

scenarios.title: Native mine and durable fleet
scenarios.steps: Spawn one persistent original NPC miner and one original NPC hauler in disposable EveJS system
scenarios.expected: The two ships retain original itemIDs and one deterministic fleetID derived from system+slot

scenarios.title: Real cargo hauler handoff
scenarios.steps: Mine source with ALIFE-07 atomic debit; transfer original cargoID to original persistent hauler
scenarios.expected: Asteroid depleted once, cargo not duplicated, hauler retains cargoID, coopHaulFleetID equals durable fleet manifest fleetID

scenarios.title: Crash and cold restart after handoff
scenarios.steps: Stop disposable server after original cargo transfer but before station arrival
scenarios.expected: Startup restores same native miner/hauler IDs, same fleetID, one original cargo stack and no new cargo grant

scenarios.title: Physical station unload after restart
scenarios.steps: Resume a real ship warp to an NPC station and verify arrival dwell, then let station warehouse commit
scenarios.expected: One authoritative station warehouse item credit and COMMITTED receipt; cargoID removed from NPC hauler exactly once

scenarios.title: Two-client and repeated restart proof
scenarios.steps: Observe the same fleet and station trade with two connected co-op clients, restart again
scenarios.expected: Both clients see same two NPC hull IDs; one source debit/receipt/warehouse credit; no duplicate fleet, order or ISK
